title.th: ประกาศตามมาตรา 4(2)

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 4(2))
Notification under Section 4(2)
N 1
G.N. No. S 308/1986
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[5th December 1986]
Pursuant to section 4(2) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Ordinances, Acts and Imperial legislation specified in the Schedule are omitted from the revised edition of Acts under section 4(1) of that Act.

Imperial Legislation
Extradition:
Order in Council (1877) directing that “the Extradition Ordinance 1877” shall have effect in the Straits Settlements as if it were part of the Imperial Act;
Straits Settlements Extradition Order 1889 as amended by the Straits Settlements Extradition Order 1901;
Straits Settlements and Protected States Fugitive Offenders Order in Council 1916;
Straits Settlements and Protected States Fugitive Offenders Order in Council 1917;
Order in Council (1918) applying Part II of the Fugitive Offenders Act 1881 (44 and 45 Vict. c. 69) to British India, Ceylon, Hong Kong, the Straits Settlements, the Federated Malay States, Johore, Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan, Trengganu, Brunei, North Borneo and Sarawak;
Order in Council (1923) directing that “the Straits Settlements Extradition Ordinance 1922” shall have effect in the Straits Settlements as if it were part of the Extradition Act 1870 (33 and 34 Vict. c. 52); and
Order in Council (1923) directing that “the Straits Settlements Fugitive Offenders Ordinance 1922” shall be recognised and have effect throughout His Majesty’s Dominions and on the High Seas as if it were part of the Fugitive Offenders Act 1881 (44 and 45 Vict. c. 69).
Merchant Shipping:
Order in Council (1869) declaring that the Master Attendant at Singapore shall be the Registrar of British Ships;
Order in Council (1891) declaring certain certificates of competency granted by the Colonial Executives of the Straits Settlements equivalent to those granted by the Board of Trade and making regulations as to such certificates;
Order in Council (1906) amending the Orders in Council of 1891 and 1893 as to Colonial Certificates of Competency;
Straits Settlements Load Line Order in Council 1893;
Order in Council (1911) confirming the Merchant Shipping Ordinance 1910 (Ordinance XXXII of 1910);
Order in Council (1926) making regulations as to the registration of vessels in the service of the Government of the Colony of the Straits Settlements;
Merchant Shipping Passenger Steamers (Straits Settlements) Order 1929;
Merchant Shipping Safety Convention (Straits Settlements) No. 1 Order 1935;
Merchant Shipping Safety Convention (Straits Settlements) No. 2 Order 1935;
Merchant Shipping Load Line Convention (Straits Settlements) No. 1 Order 1939;
Merchant Shipping Load Line Convention (Straits Settlements) No. 2 Order 1939;
Merchant Shipping Safety Convention (Singapore) No. 1 Order 1953; and
Merchant Shipping Safety Convention (Singapore) No. 2 Order 1953.
Marriage and Divorce:
Marriage of British Subjects (Facilities) Act 1915; and
Order in Council (1916) applying the Marriage of British Subjects (Facilities) Act 1915.
Naval Defence:
Straits Settlements Naval Defence Order 1936;
Malayan Naval Force Order 1949; and
Malayan Royal Naval Volunteer Reserve (Singapore Division) Order 1952.
Miscellaneous:
Colonial Probates Act 1892;
Order in Council (1893) applying the Colonial Probates Act 1892 to the Straits Settlements;
Death Duties (Relief against Double Duty) (Singapore) Order 1949;
Death Duties (Northern Ireland) (Relief against Double Duty) (Singapore) Order 1949; and
Double Taxation Relief (Taxes on Income) (Singapore) Order 1949.
